demos.say: One centimetre per interval;0→6 counts six gaps
Nonzero start2→7; five intervals, end label not length

items.unit: Pencil/ant/book→cm; classroom/pool/tree height→m. Categorical small/large advice, hand-palm hint.
items.estimate: Pencil15cm/15m/1cm, door2m/2cm/20m, frog8cm/8m/80m, bed2m/2cm/20cm. Approximate size knowledge assumed.
items.mark: a0..3,len2..6,b=a+len. line0..10 with cm, identify endb. Hint counted intervals; whyAt wrong-origin/one-short/one-long.
items.ruler: a0or1..3,len3..7,b<=10. rulerArt10 exact endpoints; answerlen, distractors endpointb andlen±1 de-duplicated.
items.transfer: 1m vs80/90/95cm, choose longer including equality distractor. Relation supplied in hint.

mediaInventory: measureanim.rulerScene slides stick then counts intervals
reconcile: Keep interval counting and origin repair, with accurate labelled endpoints. Screen pixels are not actual centimetres.
Both m andcm can express any length; teach convenient units, not categorical physical impossibility of the other.
No arbitrary object names, hand-size/body-step exact standards, subtraction gate or long conversion drill.

alignment.limitations: Current authored lessons are drafts; author software tests do not establish real-world handling, strategy or human efficacy.
